messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering.delta spike detected in prod-us-1. token_count_delta > 10% over 5m. Potential overage flags being emitted to customers. Paging on-call.
maya: saw the alert, jumping in. which pipeline is spiking? :eyes:
sam: looks like ingest-emitter consumer laged -> retries kicked in. Kafka consumer lag ~47k across partition set. some emitters show duplicate submission IDs. customers likely see delayed then doubled counts.
aj: can we disable retries briefly? emitter retry policy = backoff x3 in config. if we short-circuit retries we stop dup emits but may lose some events.
liam: i'm oncall, taking lead. silencing non-critical alerts now. maya, sam — can you post a quick scope query (per-customer token delta vs baseline) so we can decide customer comms?
sam: posted query in logs channel, paste here for quick reference:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_5m, avg(tokens_1h) as baseline
FROM metering.tokens
WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens_5m DESC
LIMIT 25;
```
sam: preliminary: ~8 customers show >25% surge, most are smaller dev accounts, 2 enterprise tenants at ~12% over baseline.
maya: emitter logs show repeated WARN: duplicate_emit id=abc123 attempt=2 origin=emitter-7 at 2024-05-17T02:15:34Z. Also a spike of consumer lag happened after a rolling deploy around 02:10. link: https://logs.redwood/c/ingest-emitter/abc123
aj: if the rolling deploy caused transient rebalancing, we should revert 02:10 change or scale consumers up. quick mitigation: increase consumer replica count from 3 -> 6 and pause emitter retries. I can apply a patch to kube-ops now.
liam: agree. aj do that. maya monitor duplication rate and token stream. sam prepare an aggregation of affected customers to drive comms. i'll update status page with "investigating billing anomalies" and flag SEV3.
aj: applying patch: `kubectl scale deployment emitter-consumer --replicas=6 -n prod-us-1` then patch configmap `emitter-retry.count=0` for hotfix.
maya: duplication rate dropped by ~70% within 60s of scaling. consumer lag down to ~3k. good signal.
sam: running backfill hold to prevent late-emitted tokens from being double-counted: toggling emitter-backfill.enabled=false for now.
liam: handoff plan: i'm taking lead through next 30m. aj stays on infra changes, maya on duplication monitoring and verifying dedupe keys, sam on customer scope + draft comms. if anyone else needs to join, ping @liam.
maya: noted. will run dedupe-key audit script and post results.
sam: drafting short customer note: "We observed transient billing/metering anomalies due to message replay after a consumer rebalance. Mitigations applied; we are evaluating whether any customers saw overage flags and will follow up with credits if needed." will share for review. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV3. Auto-escalate to SEV2 if unresolved after 2 hours or if >10 customers affected.
liam: closing pager to broad oncall, keeping thread open for live updates. next update in 10m unless scope changes. :white_check_mark:
